verdict.rationale: Honeybadger ships an official CLI (Ruby gem) documented with commands like `honeybadger deploy` for notifying deployments and other utilities, confirmed by docs and probe. It exists as a first-party tool a script or AI agent could invoke, though it is narrow in scope (deployment notification, limited to Ruby ecosystem) and not marketed as AI-native. Missing for 10: broader multi-language CLI coverage, AI-specific CLI features/flags, and independent/hands-on confirmation of agentic usage.
